thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for service: model-catalog-config-prod — policy: critical-config-diff
incident-bot: page fired -> @oncall (kevin)

kevin: Acked via PD, taking it. Seeing a flood of config-diff errors in catalog apply job.
kevin: Paging details: config apply failures 5xx -> 18% of catalog requests, spikes at 23:11 UTC

pagerduty: Alert acknowledged by kevin at 2025-06-03T23:12:56Z

sanjay: I see the failure in the apply job: tokenizer field resolution throws: "Unknown tokenizer: auto-v2"
sanjay: Root cause looks like a bad default slipped into the model revision metadata during last night's auto-rollout.

maria: Which revision? can we pin to prior?

sanjay: affected revision: models/redwood/gptq-3b@rev:2025-05-30-rc (rev id: rev-20250530-rc12)
sanjay: previous working revision: rev-20250412-stable (pin -> rev-20250412-stable)

elaine: Customer impact: APM shows increased tokenization errors for hosted-api customers using that model id. Roughly 1200 failing requests in last 20m, top tenants: acme-inc, atlas-ai. Some return 400 with "tokenizer not found" and others return garbled tokens.

kevin: Repro (from devbox):
```
# hitting catalog resolution
curl -s -X POST https://catalog.internal/api/resolve -d '{"model":"redwood/gptq-3b","rev":"rev-20250530-rc12"}' | jq .
{
  "status": "error",
  "error": "TokenizerSpecError: Unknown tokenizer 'auto-v2'"
}
```

kevin: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Pin serving bundles to rev-20250412-stable 2) Rollback catalog metadata for gptq-3b 3) Disable auto-rollout for catalog until we have a clean gating job.

maria: I can run the rollback. Will patch the catalog-entry and push.

deploy-bot: rolling back model-catalog entry redwood/gptq-3b from rev-20250530-rc12 -> rev-20250412-stable (initiated by maria)

maria: Applied rollback, waiting for propagation. Patch snippet:
```
PATCH /catalog/v1/models/redwood/gptq-3b
{ "revision": "rev-20250412-stable", "metadata": { "tokenizer": "sentencepiece-v1" } }
```

oncall-sre: Confirming route table flush and cache invalidation kicked off (kv-cache invalidation job id: kv-inv-4421).

kevin: Observability: tokenization errors dropping -> 18% -> 4% within 2 minutes of rollback. Good signal.

elaine: Customer impact update: failing requests now at ~60 in last 10m, most are retrying successfully. Contacting top 3 impacted accounts with heads-up.

sanjay: Root cause analysis notes: the rollout pipeline introduced a new default metadata key `tokenizer: auto-v2` only present in RC builds. Staging gating did not include tokenizer resolution step because staging uses a different catalog resolver that tolerates unknown tokenizers. Engineering oversight: missing integration test for tokenizer resolution in the catalog gating stage.

maria: I've also disabled auto-rollout for the 'gptq-3b' model id in the rollout service:
```
PATCH /rollout/configs/gptq-3b
{ "auto_rollout": false }
```
deploy-bot: rollout config updated (auto_rollout=false) by maria

kevin: PagerDuty escalation: No need to escalate to SRE lead if errors continue to fall. Kevin remains on call until 02:00 UTC, then handoff to sanjay.

kevin: action items assigned: @maria patch catalog + postmortem draft, @sanjay add tokenizer-resolution test to gating pipeline, @elaine customer outreach and incident timeline.

maria: Creating postmortem draft now in /incidents/pm-templates. Will include mitigation timeline and follow-ups.

sanjay: Quick fix PR for gating test opened: https://git.internal/redwood/catalog/+/PR-678
sanjay: Will submit for review ASAP.

kevin: Looks like deploy-bot rollback succeeded and requests are recovering. Leaving note to disable auto-deploy for model-catalog repo overnight.

pagerduty: Incident resolved? please close when postmortem ready and customers notified.

elaine: Confirmed outreach sent to Acme and Atlas with summary + ETA for postmortem.

kevin: Marking this thread as incident follow-up. Will handoff to sanjay at 02:00 UTC for overnight watch and remediation work. Good job team. :clap:

sanjay: Taking over oncall. Will continue with gating tests and patch the rollout pipeline first thing.

maria: Postmortem link (draft): https://docs.internal/incidents/2025-06-03-model-catalog-config-default-tokenizer

kevin: Closing PD alert. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
